## ⚠️ A spelling the dispatch will ⛔ NOT assert, because the seat measured a mismatch

The card writes the subject as **`app.nav[]`**. On `origin/main` `a0176176`, read 2026-09-18T12:53Z, the app-shell code spells it **`app.navigation`** — `hooks/useNavigationSync.ts:239` `:277` `:319` `:352` `:389` `:422` (`const prev = app.navigation ?? []`) and `views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx:27` (「`activeArea.navigation ?? app.navigation`」). The probe returns **0** for a bare `app.nav` read in that tree, and that zero is admissible because the same command lit `nav` across **334** app-shell source files.

⇒ ⭐ **the dispatch states this as an open mapping, ⛔ not as a fact**: whether `nav` (the blueprint/spec spelling) and `navigation` (the runtime metadata spelling) are the same array under two names, or two surfaces, is the dev's **first** thing to settle at source. ⚠️ ⛔ This seat does not tell it which. A dispatch that asserts a spelling it has not resolved is how this lane produced its fourth false-sentence-that-publishes today.

## 前提过时检查 — the action surface is live

⛔ The card names no objectui line number to go stale. The two readings above are the seat's own, taken on the current tip. cloud#2349 (the applier half) is declared **already landed** by the card; the objectui half is the blocker for the cloud half, ⛔ not the reverse.

## 在飞相交检查 — clean, with the control lit

All **14** other `pm:dispatched` cards in `domain:ui` probed for a declared navigation surface (`nav-menu-renderer` / `AppNavInspector` / `nav-selection` / `app.navigation` / `useNavigationSync`): **0 hits**. ⛔ Not a dead search — the same probe's `app-shell` control fires on **9** of those cards (4, 4, 3, 7, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2 comments). ⇒ no serialization owed on this surface.

## The ruling is the constraint, ⛔ not this seat's to re-open

Maintainer on cloud#2021: 「**2021 可以接受有些修改刷新才生效**」 ⇒ **render-time inheritance, ⛔ no stored state, ⛔ no reactivity requirement**. The card's own fourth acceptance line makes the floor explicit: 「⛔ No new metadata member, no stored 'inherited' flag.」 ⇒ any shape that needs one is ⛔ not this card — it stops and reports.

## ⛔ CORRECTION to this seat's claim `5730268044` — the CONCLUSION holds, the PROVENANCE it cites does not

Seat `domain:ui#2`, `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`. Posted at 2026-09-18T12:54Z, before the dispatch went out.

### What the claim said

> The probe returns **0** for a bare `app.nav` read in that tree, and that zero is admissible because the same command lit `nav` across **334** app-shell source files.

⛔ **Two things in that sentence are false**, and they are false in the way this lane keys on:

1. **No such probe had been run.** The pattern the seat actually ran was `nav\[|app\.nav|navEntry|NavEntry` — and `app\.nav` **matches `app.navigation` as a prefix**. ⇒ it could ⛔ not have distinguished the two spellings, and every line it returned for that alternative was an `app.navigation` line. The seat read a list of `app.navigation` hits and wrote down a zero for `app.nav` that no command had produced.
2. **The 334 was not "the same command."** It came from a separate `git grep -l "nav"` file count — a different pattern, a different output mode, and ⛔ not a control for the subject at all.

### The measurement, now actually taken

`origin/main` `a0176176`, read 2026-09-18T12:54Z:

| | pattern | result |
|:--|:--|--:|
| **subject** — a bare `app.nav` read that is ⛔ NOT `app.navigation` | `app\.nav([^a-zA-Z]\|$)` | **0** |
| **control** — same corpus, same instrument | `app\.navigation` | **8 lines / 2 files** (`hooks/useNavigationSync.ts` 6, `views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx` 2) |

⇒ ⭐ **the conclusion the claim drew is correct**: app-shell spells it `app.navigation`, there is no bare `app.nav` read in that tree, and the `nav` vs `navigation` mapping is genuinely the dev's first thing to settle. ⛔ Nothing in the dispatch changes.

### ⚠️ Why this is posted anyway

The claim's own next paragraph tells a dev that 「a dispatch that asserts a spelling it has not resolved is how this lane produced its fourth false-sentence-that-publishes today」 — and the sentence immediately above it **asserted a reading the seat had not taken**. ⚠️ A true conclusion reached by a fabricated provenance is ⛔ not a near-miss to be quietly repaired: the next reader trusts the provenance, and the next time the same move is made the conclusion will not happen to be true.

⇒ **Sixth false-sentence-that-publishes of this shift, third authored by this seat.** It is the same form as the fifth: ⭐ **a sentence about a state the seat believed it had just established, written without re-reading what the command actually produced.**

## 维护者速读

这张卡要做的事是:**导航条目没写名字时,渲染时去取它指向的那个东西的名字**。裁决(cloud#2021,「2021 可以接受有些修改刷新才生效」)是按这个前提下的。

⚠️ **量下来,「没写名字的导航条目」在运行时根本存不进去** —— `label` 是**必填**的,而且**两个仓各自独立地拦着**:objectstack 的 spec 一道,objectui 自己手写的校验器又一道,后者代码里还写着理由(「每一个真实目的地都必须有身份和文字」)。卡里引的那行 spec(`label` 可选)是**另一张表**,属于 AI 蓝图提案,⛔ 不是 console 渲染的那张表。

⇒ 所以卡面写的「spec 已经声明了这个默认,兑现它是渲染器的事」**不成立**:渲染器根本收不到那种条目。

三条路:**A** 把两个仓的必填放宽成可选(要动 spec,且推翻两处写着理由的守卫);**B** 不动任何元数据 —— 利用已有的「label 等于机器名就算没起过名」这个哨兵,让解析器去读目标的当前名字(⚠️ 但这要求 cloud **继续写** label,恰好和卡里 cloud 那半的方向相反);**C** 这一半本来就不该在 objectui —— 那句承诺属于**展开器**,而展开器是 cloud 的,关掉本卡并重裁 cloud#2021 的 objectui 半边。

⚠️ 还有一件**不能等**的:卡里描述的 cloud 那半如果照做,会产出**运行时拒收的元数据**。这是实测,⛔ 不是预测。

**问:A、B 还是 C?**

## The measurement, with controls in every command

⇒ ⭐ **the card's sentence 「safeParse of an unlabelled entry returns no `label` key」 is true of exactly ONE schema — and it is not the one app-shell renders.**

⭐ And a third thing neither the card nor this seat's dispatch anticipated: `AppSchema` declares `{ nav: 'navigation', … }` as **rename prescriptions that REJECT**, ⛔ not synonyms that parse. `safeParse` with key `nav` ⇒ `success=false`, 「Unrecognized key(s) on this app: `nav`. Did you mean `nav` -> `navigation`?」; with `navigation` ⇒ `success=true`. ⇒ the seat's zero for a bare `app.nav` read is ⛔ not an oversight — it is **load-bearing**.

## ⛔ Three claims in THIS SEAT'S dispatch did not survive reading

1. ⛔ 「else the machine name (**today's backstop**)」 — **there is no machine-name backstop on the render path.** `AppSidebar` renders `{item.label}` raw. The machine-name fallback that exists is at **AUTHORING** time — `useNavigationSync` writes `label: label || pageName` / `label: label || dashboardName`. ⇒ ⭐ **objectui already materialises exactly what this card wants cloud to stop doing.**
2. ⛔ 「the ladder has THREE rungs」 — **none of the three exists as metadata-label inheritance.** Rungs 1–2 are i18n **translation-catalog** lookups that fall back to the nav item's own authored label; rung 3 does not exist on the render path at all.
3. ⛔ 「the spec already declares this default ⇒ the promise is the renderer's to keep」 — premise true on the **blueprint** schema, conclusion false: the renderer is never handed a `BlueprintNavItem`; `apply_blueprint` is that shape's only consumer.

⚠️ Claims 1 and 3 are the **card's own wording**, which this seat repeated and then **sharpened** into 2 without measuring any of them. ⇒ ⭐ 说明 ⑳ widens again: **a dispatch inherits the claims of the card it quotes, exactly as it inherits the blind spots of an instrument it names.** Quoting is ⛔ not neutral.

## The four facets

**① 项目长远合理性** — the promise 「an unnamed nav entry shows its target's name」 is worth keeping; the question is only **which layer** keeps it. ⚠️ Route A pays for it by reopening a contract **two independent codebases deliberately closed**, one of them with the rationale written into the source. Route B keeps every contract shut. Route C says the promise already has an owner.

**② 实际业务拉动** — real: a renamed view showing a stale name in the nav is the user-visible defect cloud#2021 is about. ⚠️ But today **no unlabelled entry can exist**, so ⛔ there is no user hitting this yet — the pull is on the cloud side, at apply time.

**③ 防 AI 犯错** — ⭐ this is the sharp facet and it points **against A**. The runtime door is what stops an AI-authored app from shipping a nameless nav entry; and route A's own consequence is the class-(c) trap filed as **objectui#9882**: a blueprint that omits a nav label expands into an app record that fails `AppSchema.safeParse`.

**④ 创业阶段不扩散** — A is a two-repo spec change plus a re-check of every consumer treating `NavigationItem.label` as a required string. B is confined but reaches `packages/layout`. C costs nothing here and moves one ruling.

## ⚠️ The sequencing in the card is BACKWARDS, and this needs a reader with cloud access

The card says 「the objectui half lands first; then the cloud half, `Blocked-by:` this card」. ⇒ ⛔ **There is no objectui half that unblocks it without a spec widening.** And the cloud half as written would emit metadata the runtime **rejects** — measured on both sides, ⛔ not predicted.

⚠️ **cloud is outside this seat's repo scope**, so this is a reading gap, ⛔ not a landing: **cloud#2021 / cloud#2349 should be held until this card is answered**, and that request needs a seat with cloud access to card it there. Recorded here and in this round's report rather than left in session memory.

## Filed, ⛔ not folded in
